functions.role: In-place coefficient-wise addition of one polynomial into another; candidate implementation counterpart to coordinate-wise polynomial addition on 256-coefficient arrays.
inputs: r: writable polynomial pointer used as the accumulator/output object
b: read-only polynomial pointer used as the addend
outputs: void; the updated coefficients are stored in r

r->coeffs[i] and b->coeffs[i] must be addressable for all i in 0..MLKEM_N-1.
The visible source provides no explicit null check, bounds check, or modular-reduction check.
postconditions_or_contracts: For each i in 0..MLKEM_N-1, r->coeffs[i] is assigned (int16_t)(old_r->coeffs[i] + old_b->coeffs[i]).
The body contains no assignment through b or b->coeffs.
The function returns after completing one fixed-length loop.
